statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-13346 (GHSA-qwm4-qh6w-59xr, PYSEC-2026-3721): pip before 26.2 decodes the path of a package URL from an index twice, so a malicious package index can make it write files to arbitrary locations on disk, even when installing wheels. It needs a malicious package index, and pip's advisory says it only materially affects pip download with --only-binary. pip 26.2 fixes it: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qwm4-qh6w-59xr, https://github.com/pypa/pip/pull/14110, https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/L2BNQGGVQCEV7DROOORQ7WFKKFF2OOQX/. k8s-sidecar is a Python application installed in a virtual environment with its dependencies. Checked every published k8s-sidecar package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository, 20 builds from 2.10.1-r0 to the current 2.14.3-r5 for both x86_64 and aarch64, each checked against the index checksum, reading the version of every pip .dist-info directory in each build; none of them bundles a wheel or zip archive. 2.10.1-r0 ships pip 26.1.2, every build from 2.10.1-r1 to 2.14.1-r1 ships pip 26.2, and the builds from 2.14.1-r2 to 2.14.3-r5 do not include pip at all. The range ends at 2.10.1-r1.

CVE-2026-13346 (GHSA-qwm4-qh6w-59xr, PYSEC-2026-3721): pip before 26.2 decodes the path of a package URL from an index twice, so a malicious package index can make it write files to arbitrary locations on disk, even when installing wheels. It needs a malicious package index, and pip's advisory says it only materially affects pip download with --only-binary. pip 26.2 fixes it: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qwm4-qh6w-59xr, https://github.com/pypa/pip/pull/14110, https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/L2BNQGGVQCEV7DROOORQ7WFKKFF2OOQX/. k8s-sidecar is a Python application installed in a virtual environment with its dependencies. Checked every published k8s-sidecar package for Alpine 3.24 in the DHI Alpine repository, 20 builds from 2.10.1-r0 to the current 2.14.3-r5 for both x86_64 and aarch64, each checked against the index checksum, reading the version of every pip .dist-info directory in each build; none of them bundles a wheel or zip archive. 2.10.1-r0 ships pip 26.1.2, every build from 2.10.1-r1 to 2.14.1-r1 ships pip 26.2, and the builds from 2.14.1-r2 to 2.14.3-r5 do not include pip at all. The range ends at 2.10.1-r1.

CVE-2026-13346 (GHSA-qwm4-qh6w-59xr): pip decoded a package URL's file name twice, so a doubly-encoded path separator from a malicious package index could make a download's file name escape its target directory. The advisory says this materially affects only pip download with --only-binary, because installing a source distribution from an untrusted index already runs its code. Upstream fixed it in pip 26.2 (https://github.com/pypa/pip/pull/14110, commit https://github.com/pypa/pip/commit/10dfb6b9005484578b386f64b9f36982e3dc6679, https://mail.python.org/archives/list/security-announce@python.org/thread/L2BNQGGVQCEV7DROOORQ7WFKKFF2OOQX/, https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-qwm4-qh6w-59xr). Checked every published py3.10-pip package for Alpine 3.23 in the DHI Alpine repository, 25.1.1-r1 to the current 26.3-r1, x86_64 and aarch64, reading pip/_internal/models/link.py, pip/_internal/network/download.py, pip/_internal/operations/prepare.py and the pip .dist-info version in each build, and the compiled link.cpython-310.pyc in the py3.10-pip-pyc package of every one of these versions. The builds 25.1.1-r1, 26.0.1-r0, 26.0.1-r1, 26.1-r0, 26.1.1-r0, 26.1.2-r0 lack the fix: Link.filename still calls urllib.parse.unquote on the already-decoded name. pip 26.1.2 was published twice: 26.1.2-r0 without the fix, and 26.1.2-r1 with the upstream commit backported (as_path_component and join_within_directory in link.py, used by network/download.py and operations/prepare.py). The compiled link module in py3.10-pip-pyc carries the same helpers from 26.1.2-r1 on and lacks them in 26.1.2-r0 and earlier. Every later build ships pip 26.2.1, 26.2.2 or 26.3, which include the upstream fix. The range ends at 26.1.2-r1.

Every later build ships pip 26.2.1, 26.2.2 or 26.3, which include the upstream fix. The compiled copies in the py3.13-pip-pyc packages of the same builds show the same split: the link.py, download.py and prepare.py bytecode lacks join_within_directory up to 26.1.2-r0 and has it from 26.1.2-r1. The range ends at 26.1.2-r1.

CVE-2026-13346 (GHSA-qwm4-qh6w-59xr, PYSEC-2026-3721): pip before 26.2 decodes the path of a package URL from an index twice, so a malicious package index can make it write files to arbitrary locations on disk, even when installing wheels. Checked every published k8s-sidecar package for Debian 13 in the DHI Debian repository, 22 builds from 2.10.1-0 to the current 2.14.3-7 for both amd64 and arm64, each matched to the repository's SHA-256 checksum, reading the version of every pip .dist-info directory in each build; none of them bundles a wheel or zip archive. 2.10.1-0 ships pip 26.1.2, every build from 2.10.1-1 to 2.14.1-0 ships pip 26.2, and the builds from 2.14.1-1 to 2.14.3-7 do not include pip at all. The range ends at 2.10.1-1.
